policy: API documentation is recorded for product calls. The consulted_before_implementation field states whether review preceded first use. No execution is inferred from documentation.

cupy.RawKernel.notes: NVRTC kernel accepts contiguous raw pointers; views are not interpreted through strides. Compilation is cached per device. The fixed-output extrema kernel is warmed before stream capture.

cupy.cuda.Stream.notes: A nonblocking stream is warmed before capturing the conditional graph body; synchronization occurs after the whole graph execution.

cupy.cuda.get_allocator.notes: Returns the active allocator used as the base for explicit capture workspace retention.

cupy.cuda.using_allocator.notes: Thread-local allocator scope retains MemoryPointer owners through graph close.

cupy.cuda.alloc.notes: Reserve one bounded device arena before conditional capture; no device algorithm runs during this allocation.

cupy.cuda.MemoryPointer.notes: Create 256-byte-aligned nonoverlapping pointers into the retained arena for captured CuPy temporaries.

cupy.cuda.get_current_stream.notes: Record an event on the producing stream and make the graph stream wait without transferring intermediate data to the host.

cupy.asarray.notes: blocking=False is asynchronous by default; use blocking=True for owned host input. Never build an array from nested device scalars; stack them.

cupy.broadcast_to.notes: Broadcast the device scalar stage standard deviation for deferred diagnostics; the returned view is read-only and requires no host transfer.

cupy.array.notes: blocking=False is asynchronous by default; use blocking=True for owned host input. Never build an array from nested device scalars; stack them.

cupy.empty.notes: Explicit dtype. No uninitialized value is read. Tagged docstrings corroborate older cached stable pages.

cupy.zeros.notes: Explicit dtype. No uninitialized value is read. Tagged docstrings corroborate older cached stable pages.

cupy.ones.notes: Explicit dtype. No uninitialized value is read. Tagged docstrings corroborate older cached stable pages.

cupy.zeros_like.notes: Explicit dtype. No uninitialized value is read. Tagged docstrings corroborate older cached stable pages.

cupy.full.notes: Explicit dtype. No uninitialized value is read. Tagged docstrings corroborate older cached stable pages.

cupy.arange.notes: Half-open bounds; sample indices and index arrays use explicit dtype.

cupy.concatenate.notes: Only join compatible device arrays, including explicit scalar-to-length-one arrays. Preserve axis and realization order.

cupy.stack.notes: Only join compatible device arrays, including explicit scalar-to-length-one arrays. Preserve axis and realization order.

cupy.vstack.notes: Only join compatible device arrays, including explicit scalar-to-length-one arrays. Preserve axis and realization order.

cupy.diff.notes: Integer/float difference; boolean diff is inequality. Cast zero-run mask to int8 first.

cupy.cumsum.notes: Int64 prefix counts for one-dimensional boolean mask compaction; result length is read explicitly before a separate scatter kernel.

cupy.sort.notes: Stable sort; zeros/plateau indices preserve round-to-even convention.

cupy.rint.notes: Nearest integer; verify ties-to-even with executable vectors before GPU acceptance.

cupy.absolute.notes: Elementwise absolute value; preserve arithmetic grouping.

cupy.max.notes: Reductions return device scalars; .item is an explicit synchronization. std uses explicit ddof; even-length median must match NumPy.

cupy.mean.notes: Reductions return device scalars; .item is an explicit synchronization. std uses explicit ddof; even-length median must match NumPy.

cupy.std.notes: Reductions return device scalars; .item is an explicit synchronization. std uses explicit ddof; even-length median must match NumPy.

cupy.median.notes: Reductions return device scalars; .item is an explicit synchronization. std uses explicit ddof; even-length median must match NumPy.

cupy.sum.notes: Reductions return device scalars; .item is an explicit synchronization. std uses explicit ddof; even-length median must match NumPy.

cupy.ptp.notes: Reductions return device scalars; .item is an explicit synchronization. std uses explicit ddof; even-length median must match NumPy.

cupy.all.notes: Return device scalar/array. Consume scalar intentionally for Python control, not NumPy evaluation.

cupy.any.notes: Return device scalar/array. Consume scalar intentionally for Python control, not NumPy evaluation.

cupy.isfinite.notes: True excludes infinity and NaN, device ufunc.

cupy.array_equal.notes: Exact equality used for stagnation; not a tolerant comparison.

cupy.where.notes: Three-argument selection. Safe denominator before division; no unsupported divide(where=...).

cupy.gradient.notes: Irregular coordinates supported; edge_order=1 to preserve reference.

cupy.linalg.solve.notes: Use cupyx.errstate(linalg="raise") to inspect solver failures; preserve the natural three-point system.

cupyx.errstate.notes: Source docs TODO. Source reviewed: linalg ignore/raise supported; over/invalid/divide non-None raise NotImplementedError. Do not copy np.errstate(over=...).

cupy.asnumpy.notes: Only explicit output/validation boundary. blocking=True. No call in numerical modules.

cupy.cuda.Device.notes: Context manager restores device; id, mem_info, compute_capability and synchronize documented.

cupy.cuda.runtime.getDeviceCount.notes: Returns available device count; failures propagate as environment BLOCKED.

cupy.random.Philox4x3210.notes: Explicit cuRAND generator, not default_rng (XORWOW). No claimed NumPy PCG64 sequence equivalence.

cupy.random.Generator.notes: Generator methods accept device output dtype; no cross-version bitstream guarantee.

cupy.random.Generator.standard_normal.notes: standard_normal(size,dtype=float64); uniform(low,high,size,dtype=float64). Native stream is separately versioned, request counter restored on failure.

cupy.random.Generator.uniform.notes: standard_normal(size,dtype=float64); uniform(low,high,size,dtype=float64). Native stream is separately versioned, request counter restored on failure.

cupyx.scipy.interpolate.CubicSpline.notes: Preserve exact interpolation choice. CubicSpline only with >3 supports. Akima classic, not MAKIMA. interp1d axis/default/error behavior checked individually.

cupyx.scipy.interpolate.PchipInterpolato.notes: Preserve exact interpolation choice. CubicSpline only with >3 supports. Akima classic, not MAKIMA. interp1d axis/default/error behavior checked individually.

cupyx.scipy.interpolate.Akima1DInterpola.notes: Preserve exact interpolation choice. CubicSpline only with >3 supports. Akima classic, not MAKIMA. interp1d axis/default/error behavior checked individually.

cupyx.scipy.interpolate.CubicHermiteSpli.notes: Preserve exact interpolation choice. CubicSpline only with >3 supports. Akima classic, not MAKIMA. interp1d axis/default/error behavior checked individually.

cupyx.scipy.interpolate.interp1d.notes: Preserve exact interpolation choice. CubicSpline only with >3 supports. Akima classic, not MAKIMA. interp1d axis/default/error behavior checked individually.

cupy.ndarray.notes: Device storage; metadata attributes shape, ndim, size, nbytes, dtype, device.id stay host. Basic and advanced indexing supported. Integer-array out-of-range wraps: generated indices must be in range.

cupy.ndarray.astype.notes: Read ndarray methods. item/conversion used only for explicit scalar control. copy owns result; reshape preserves order; no repeated-index scatter writes.

cupy.ndarray.copy.notes: Read ndarray methods. item/conversion used only for explicit scalar control. copy owns result; reshape preserves order; no repeated-index scatter writes.

cupy.ndarray.sum.notes: Read ndarray methods. item/conversion used only for explicit scalar control. copy owns result; reshape preserves order; no repeated-index scatter writes.

cupy.ndarray.item.notes: Read ndarray methods. item/conversion used only for explicit scalar control. copy owns result; reshape preserves order; no repeated-index scatter writes.

cupy.ndarray.__getitem__.notes: Read ndarray methods. item/conversion used only for explicit scalar control. copy owns result; reshape preserves order; no repeated-index scatter writes.

cupy.ufunc.notes: Elementwise broadcasting for arrays/scalars; no assumed NumPy-only keyword arguments.

cupy.add.notes: Elementwise arithmetic, preserve written grouping; no fusion/fast-math. Tagged source corroborates stale documentation.

cupy.subtract.notes: Elementwise arithmetic, preserve written grouping; no fusion/fast-math. Tagged source corroborates stale documentation.

cupy.multiply.notes: Elementwise arithmetic, preserve written grouping; no fusion/fast-math. Tagged source corroborates stale documentation.

cupy.divide.notes: Elementwise arithmetic, preserve written grouping; no fusion/fast-math. Tagged source corroborates stale documentation.

cupy.negative.notes: Elementwise arithmetic, preserve written grouping; no fusion/fast-math. Tagged source corroborates stale documentation.

cupy.equal.notes: Strict comparisons including equality in boundary branches unchanged; no epsilon tie rule.

cupy.not_equal.notes: Strict comparisons including equality in boundary branches unchanged; no epsilon tie rule.

cupy.less.notes: Strict comparisons including equality in boundary branches unchanged; no epsilon tie rule.

cupy.less_equal.notes: Strict comparisons including equality in boundary branches unchanged; no epsilon tie rule.

cupy.greater.notes: Strict comparisons including equality in boundary branches unchanged; no epsilon tie rule.

cupy.greater_equal.notes: Strict comparisons including equality in boundary branches unchanged; no epsilon tie rule.

cupy.bitwise_and.notes: Boolean masks use elementwise operators &, | (not Python and/or).

cupy.bitwise_or.notes: Boolean masks use elementwise operators &, | (not Python and/or).
